limitations: Diffusion assumes closed, well-mixed fixed volumes without voltage, water movement or reaction; energy equations use ideal activities and fixed voltage.
The proportional-feedback model excludes delay, saturation and adaptation; it is not a glucose or blood-pressure calibration.
All numerical trajectories and phase representations are synthetic teaching constructions; no patient fitting or measured protein kinetics is claimed.
Scranton et al. 2025 mouse/myocyte evidence is a bounded research extension, not a demonstrated human therapy.
Some Bookshelf/IUPHAR sources were accessible only as indexed excerpts, and the CFTR original study at indexed-abstract depth; exact source access limits remain in the reader.
Source-frame inspection is bounded sampling, not continuous video/audio. Private browser PDF proofs include an installed extension overlay and are not public PDF deliverables.

Figure2.1 sources are independent specimens/scales: specialized extracted Torpedo AChR membrane reconstruction, uncalibrated adjacent-cell TEM of unspecified species, and human HeLa FXm osmotic assay; not a normal-human or RBC bilayer/movie.

HeLa movie source clocks are minutes with separate segments; publisher seconds/30fps are not acquisition timing. FXm volume uses calibrated integrated fluorescence deficit, not projected footprint alone.
